intended_object: The subspace (submodule) of compact operators inside the space of continuous (semi)linear maps M₁ →SL[σ] M₄, from the docstring and name.
explanation: The carrier is the set of continuous semilinear maps satisfying `IsCompactOperator`. That predicate says some neighbourhood of 0 is mapped into a compact set, which is Mathlib's general topological-vector-space version of "maps bounded sets to relatively compact sets". In normed spaces the two are equivalent. The closure proofs use the existing lemmas: `isCompactOperator_zero`, `IsCompactOperator.add` (which needs `ContinuousAdd`, supplied by `IsTopologicalAddGroup`) and `IsCompactOperator.smul` (which needs `ContinuousConstSMul`). The setting is fully general: any topological modules over semirings with a ring homomorphism σ. Assuming an additive group on the codomain is a harmless convention that matches the hypotheses Mathlib uses for the module structure on continuous linear maps. This is the standard definition of the submodule of compact operators, as found in Mathlib itself.
